question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

They each listened carefully to what __**each other**__ said.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the other**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The improvement required in the sentence is that '**each other**' is to be replaced with '**the other**'.
 
• This is to be done
